feature_title: Traces LLM Insights — model-grouped panels exclude spans without a model

rationale.edition: Both changed files live under web/src/plugins/traces/config/ — the open-source frontend tree (openobserve repo), not any enterprise-owned path (no enterprise/, o2_enterprise/, src/enterprise/). No enterprise keywords (cipher/SSO/SAML/RBAC/SDR/sensitive-data/logo-management) appear in the paths or symbols, so this is an OSS change.
rationale.skip: No skip marker was present: feature_hint.txt and trigger_comment.txt are both empty and no tests-added label was passed. The change alters SQL query definitions that drive the LLM insights panels rendered in the Traces UI, which is a user-facing behavior change, so it is not skipped.
rationale.e2e: The panels grouped by model (cost-trend, token-trend, latency-by-model, spans-by-model, tokens-by-model) now scope to spans with a model and drop the synthetic 'unknown' bucket, changing what a user sees in the LLM insights view. E2E is warranted to verify the panels render with only real models and no 'unknown' bucket when gen_ai spans include tool/evaluator spans that carry no model.
rationale.area: The change lives in web/src/plugins/traces/config/ and affects panels surfaced in the Traces plugin's LLM insights feature, so Traces is the matching area (sibling specs such as tracesSearch.spec.js and tracesAnalyzeDimensions.spec.js live there).
rationale.group: The Traces shard in the OSS ci-matrix (ci_matrix_cloud.json) has actual_folder 'Traces' and hosts all trace-related specs, making it the closest existing group; no dedicated LLM-insights group exists.
rationale.existing_tests: No Playwright E2E specs in the diff. The only test file changed is web/src/plugins/traces/config/llmInsightsPanels.spec.ts, which is a Vitest unit test under web/src (not tests/ui-testing/playwright-tests/), so it does not count as E2E coverage.
